settings.profileAbout: How people see you on this instance.
settings.friendsAbout: Who can reach you, and what your friends see. Kept on the instance, for every device.
settings.appearanceAbout: How fuwa looks on this computer, the same themes as everywhere else.
settings.backgroundAbout: A picture and an effect behind the app, under any theme without its own.
settings.motionReducedNote: Things appear in place, without moving. Nothing bounces or slides.
settings.motionFullNote: Things spring into place, slide and glide. Reduced keeps them still.
settings.notificationsHint: For messages that arrive while you're looking elsewhere: a card in the corner, or your computer's own notification while fuwa is in the background.
settings.notifyForHint: In servers and channels you haven't set yourself, from their bell. Private messages always notify you.
settings.streamerAbout: Keep private things off your stream.
settings.streamerHint: Hides instance addresses, your username, invite links and what private messages say in notifications. For streaming or sharing your screen.
settings.accountsAbout: Every instance you're signed in to here. Signing out also wipes the private messages this computer kept for it.
settings.keyboardAbout: Shortcuts that work everywhere in the app. Click one to change it.
settings.privacyAbout: What this app tells anyone, and only if you let it.
settings.updatesAbout: New versions of the app, checked before they run.
settings.developerHint: Shows Copy ID on servers, channels, people and messages, in their right-click menus. Handy for bots, the API and bug reports.
settings.credits: Made by Waifu Devs. Private messages are end-to-end encrypted with MLS; the font is M PLUS Rounded 1c (SIL Open Font License); icons are Lucide.
settings.streamerHidePersonalHint: A self-hosted address can be a home IP. Addresses and your username turn into dots everywhere in the app.
voice.micBlocked: macOS isn't letting fuwa use your microphone. Allow it in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, then Microphone.
voice.noSpeakers: No speakers found: you can't hear others.
account.bioPlaceholder: A little about you. Markdown works.
account.pictureTypes: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP. Square pictures look best.
account.notAPicture: That isn't a picture fuwa can use (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP).
account.linkedPassword: You sign in here with waifu.dev, so there's no password to change on this instance.
account.passwordChanged: Changed. Your other devices were signed out.
account.signInFirst: Sign in to an instance first. Your account lives there.
friends.signInFirst: Sign in to an instance first. Your friends live there.
friends.blockingNote: Blocking someone, from their profile or your friends list, stops them whatever these say.
friends.activityHint: Games and apps this app sees, shown to people who share a server with you. Nothing is kept: it's gone when you stop.
keys.note: Shortcuts work while fuwa is in front. They're written the same as the web app's, so a combo means the same in both. Click one and press the new keys; Escape stops.
look.pictureNeedsInstance: Its picture needs an instance to live on; sign in and import it again.
look.full: There are 50 themes here already; delete one to make room.
look.exported: Saved {theme}. Open it in any fuwa app to use it.
look.followSystem: Light and dark like my computer
look.omarchy: Matches your Omarchy theme, {theme}, and changes with it.
look.followSystemHint: Switches between a light theme and a dark one when your computer does.
background.needInstance: Pictures live on an instance; sign in to one to add them.
background.themeHasOwn: {theme} brings its own background, so this one shows under your other themes.
background.effectNote: Moving effects draw at most 30 frames a second, and stop while fuwa is behind other windows.
privacy.sentErrors: Kinds of errors and where in the app they happened
privacy.sentTimings: How long things took: starting up, catching up, slow frames and requests
privacy.sentUsage: How often a few features are used
privacy.sentVersion: The app's version and your OS family (Windows, macOS or Linux)
privacy.never: Never messages, names, file names, ids or addresses. It goes only to your own instance, which adds it to its hourly report to Waifu Devs, and nothing is sent while the instance's own telemetry is off.
privacy.off: Off: nothing is counted, and what was waiting is gone.
privacy.nowhere: No instance you're signed in to takes reports right now (its telemetry is off), so they wait here, up to 64 of each.
privacy.reportsHint: Sends anonymous counts of what went wrong and what was slow to your own instance, so Waifu Devs can find and fix it.
privacy.gameActivityHint: Games and apps that report to Discord on this computer can show what you're doing here too, once you allow each one. Who sees it follows your status settings on each instance.
updates.thisIs: This is fuwa desktop {version}, compatibility date {date}.
updates.readyNote: It only installs when you choose to. Until then this version keeps running, start after start.
updates.how: fuwa asks {instance} about new versions and downloads them through it, so GitHub, where releases live, never sees your address, and nothing about you goes with the request. Before an update runs, fuwa checks it against Waifu Devs' release signature and its SHA-256; one that doesn't match is thrown away. An update never installs or restarts the app by itself.
updates.autoHint: New versions are fetched and checked so they're ready when you are; nothing installs until you press Restart to update. Off, fuwa only tells you when one is out.
updates.notesFrom: As {instance} passed them on; release notes aren't signed.
sheet.noShortcut: Give this sheet a shortcut on the Keyboard page.
sheet.about: The same as in the web app. Change any of them in settings.
server.overviewAbout: Its name, picture and a few words, and how it notifies people by default.
server.invitesAbout: The links that let people in. Revoke one and it stops working at once.
server.rolesAbout: Who can do what. Members take the color of their highest role.
server.membersAbout: Everyone here. Time out, kick or ban the people you rank above.
server.auditLogAbout: Every change people made here with their permissions.
server.notificationsHint: For people who haven't picked their own. Big servers usually pick only @mentions.
server.joinMessagesHint: Where fuwa says hi when someone joins.
server.noInvitesHint: Make one and send it to someone.
server.noBansHint: Bans you make show up here.
server.audit.sharedUpdate: {actor} changed what the other server may do in {channel}
server.agents.none: No agents here yet. Add one by its username; agents are made under Settings, Agents in the web app.
server.automod.intro: AutoMod reads each message as it's sent or edited. Blocked words, mention spam and links are caught before anyone sees them; the Smart filter answers a moment after, and takes blocked messages down then. People who can manage the server are never caught, so try a rule with the box under it rather than in chat.
server.automod.tryNote: What you write here goes to the provider, the same way members' messages will.
server.automod.eachKindHint: Flags post to your alert channel and let the message through. The bar is how sure the provider must be.
server.roles.intro: Higher roles outrank lower ones. Move them with the arrows.
server.channels.intro: Move them with the arrows, into and out of categories.
server.emoji.tooBig: {width}×{height} is too big; {max} a side at most.
server.emoji.tooManyFrames: That moving picture has too many frames for its size.
server.emoji.badType: Emoji are PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP pictures.
server.onboarding.needsStep: Add a step first, or leave onboarding off.
server.onboarding.focusHint: Drag the dot onto what matters. It stays in view however the banner is cut.
server.onboarding.stepsHint: Up to {max}, in order. Server rules show up for anyone who still has to agree, even without a rules step.
server.welcome.tooLong: The few words are {max} characters at most.
server.welcome.empty: Add a few words or a channel first.
server.welcome.enabledHint: New members see it once, after agreeing to any rules. Anyone can open it again from the server menu.
server.welcome.channelsHint: Up to {max}, in this order. People only see the ones they're allowed into.
server.welcome.previewEmpty: Add a few words or a channel to see it here.
server.welcome.off: Off: new members go straight to the server.
server.shared.approveHintOn: Their people will read everything said in #{channel}, earlier messages included, and write there. They're on another instance, so check their key fingerprint first.
server.shared.approveHint: Their people will read everything said in #{channel}, earlier messages included, and write there.
server.shared.notAcross: Messages don't cross instances yet. Their key fingerprint:
server.shared.notCode: That doesn't look like a share code.
profileItems.effectTooBig: That file is too big to be an effect.
video.cameraBlocked: Your system isn't letting fuwa use the camera. Allow it in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, then Camera.
video.screenBlocked: Your system isn't letting fuwa record the screen. Allow it in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, then Screen & System Audio Recording.
video.nothingToShare: There's nothing to share here. On Linux, sharing a screen needs an X11 session for now.
calls.screenSound.text: Everything this computer plays. Your call's sound stays out.
calls.screenSound.needsServer: Sharing sound needs PulseAudio or PipeWire, and this computer runs neither.
calls.screenSound.needsMacos: Sharing sound needs macOS 13 or later.
calls.screenSound.needsWindows: Sharing sound needs Windows 10 version 2004 or later.
calls.screenSound.blocked: macOS isn't letting fuwa record this computer's sound. Allow it in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, then Screen & System Audio Recording, and share again.
calls.screenSound.failed: This computer's sound didn't start, so your screen is shared without it.
sounds.filesHint: Each sound can play another tune, or a sound file of yours (WAV, MP3, FLAC or OGG, up to 8 seconds). Files stay on this computer.
sounds.tooBig: That file is too big; sounds can be up to {size}.
sounds.notSound: That doesn't play as a sound. Try {types}.
sounds.cantSave: Couldn't keep a copy of that file.
reactions.clearOneConfirm: Remove every {emoji} reaction from this message? This can't be undone.
voice.pttEverywhere: Works while a game or another app is in front too. The game still gets the key.
voice.pttAllow: macOS hears push to talk only while fuwa is in front, until you let fuwa use Input Monitoring in System Settings, under Privacy & Security.
voice.pttInFront: Wayland doesn't let one app hear keys meant for another, so push to talk works only while fuwa is in front.
overlay.title: Game overlay
overlay.about: Your call and your messages, over the game you're playing.
overlay.onHint: Who's in your call, lit up while they talk, and messages that would notify you, in a corner over the game. Clicks go straight through to the game.
overlay.showGamesHint: While a game covers the screen, or a game says what you're playing.
overlay.showGamesMac: While a game says what you're playing. macOS doesn't tell apps what's on screen.
overlay.showCallsHint: Whenever you're in a call and fuwa isn't in front.
overlay.speakersOnlyHint: Everyone else in the call stays out of the way until they speak.
overlay.notificationsHint: Messages that would notify you show over the game, instead of as the system's notifications.
overlay.keyHint: Press {keys} in a game to click in the overlay: mute, deafen, hang up or open a message in fuwa. Press it again or Esc to go back.
overlay.using: Press {keys} or Esc to go back to your game
overlay.usingNoKey: Give “Use the game overlay” a shortcut to click in the overlay.
overlay.exclusive: Games in exclusive full screen draw over every window, the overlay too. Play in borderless or windowed to see it.
overlay.wayland: The game overlay needs X11: Wayland doesn't let one app draw over another or hear keys meant for it.
overlay.allowKeys: macOS needs to let fuwa use Input Monitoring before the overlay's key works while a game is in front.
modView.title: Mod View
modView.permissionAbout: See reports and what AutoMod caught, look into a member's messages and history, and keep notes about them. Acting on someone still takes its own permission.
modView.reasonHint.spam: Ads, floods or the same thing over and over.
modView.reasonHint.harassment: Bullying, threats or going after someone.
modView.reasonHint.hate: Attacks on people for who they are.
modView.reasonHint.sexual: Sexual content that doesn't belong here.
modView.reasonHint.violence: Gore, or wishing or threatening harm.
modView.reasonHint.scam: Phishing, fake giveaways or stealing accounts.
modView.reasonHint.rules: Breaks this server's rules some other way.
modView.reasonHint.other: Tell the moderators in the note.
modView.report.messageAbout: Tell this server's moderators what's wrong with {name}'s message.
modView.report.memberAbout: Tell this server's moderators what's wrong.
modView.report.private: Only the moderators see this. {name} isn't told.
modView.report.thanksAbout: The moderators will take a look. {name} won't know it was you.
modView.queue.about2: What AutoMod caught and what members reported, newest first.
modView.case.pick: Pick a case to see it here.
modView.case.gone: This case isn't here any more.
modView.case.neverSent: Never sent: AutoMod kept it back.
modView.case.deleted: Deleted since. This is what it said.
modView.case.edited: Edited since. This is what it said then.
modView.case.timedOut: Its author was timed out for {duration}.
modView.member.title: Member
modView.member.about: Their time here, what moderators did and your team's notes.
modView.member.notesAbout: Only people with Use Mod View see these.
modView.member.notePlaceholder: Write a note for the other moderators
modView.member.noMessages: No messages in channels you can see.
modView.member.noHistory: Moderators haven't done anything to them.
economy.nav.economyAbout: Currencies, how members earn them, and the shop.
economy.nav.financesAbout: What's held, earned and spent, and every movement.
economy.permission.manageAbout: Make and change the server's currencies, how they're earned and what the shop sells, and see its finances.
economy.permission.grantAbout: Give members currency, or take it away, one by one or a whole role at once. Each one goes in the audit log.
economy.actionHint.message: For each message sent, at most once per cooldown.
economy.actionHint.reaction: When someone reacts to their message, at most once per cooldown.
economy.actionHint.voice: For each minute in a voice channel with someone else.
economy.actionHint.game: For each minute playing a game, while they share what they're doing in this server. Apps say what's being played, so a daily cap is worth setting.
economy.actionHint.daily: Claimed once a day from the shop, more for days in a row.
economy.actionHint.join: Once, when they join the server.
economy.currency.title: Currencies
economy.currency.about: What members earn here and spend in the shop.
economy.currency.none: No currencies yet. Make one to start the shop.
economy.currency.name: Name
economy.currency.nameNeeded: Give it a name, up to 32 characters.
economy.currency.descriptionLong: The description goes up to 200 characters.
economy.currency.transferableHint: Let members give some of theirs to each other.
economy.currency.earningHint: Turn on the ways members get it, and how much each gives.
economy.currency.gamesHint: One per line, as the game names itself. Leave empty for any game.
economy.currency.gamesRange: A rule names up to 50 games, each up to 128 characters.
economy.currency.cooldownRange: A cooldown is from 0 to 86,400 seconds (a day).
economy.currency.deleteAsk: Delete {name}? Everyone's balance of it and its listings go too, for good.
economy.listing.title: Shop
economy.listing.about: What members can buy with the server's currencies.
economy.listing.needCurrency: Make a currency first, then put things in the shop.
economy.listing.noRoles: No roles you can sell. A role in the shop can't carry moderation or management permissions, and must be below your highest role.
economy.listing.roleHint: Only roles without moderation or management permissions, below your own.
economy.listing.noItems: This server offers no profile items yet.
economy.listing.itemHint: Once it's listed, only people who bought it can wear it here.
economy.listing.name: Name
economy.listing.nameOptional: Name (the role's or item's when blank)
economy.listing.availableHint: Off keeps it out of the shop without deleting it.
economy.listing.nameNeeded: Give it a name, up to 60 characters.
economy.listing.deleteAsk: Delete this listing? What people already bought stays theirs.
economy.listing.gachaOnlyHint: Members can't buy it; it only drops from gacha banners that list it. Banners are set up in the web app.
economy.finances.none: Make a currency on the Economy page to see its finances.
economy.finances.ledgerAbout: Every movement of this currency, newest first.
economy.give.title: Give {name} currency
economy.give.about: It lands in their wallet at once, with your reason.
economy.give.roleAbout: Everyone with the role gets the same amount.
economy.give.audited: This goes in the audit log.
economy.gacha.about: Pull for a random prize. Everyone sees the drop rates.
economy.shop.title: Shop
economy.ledger.title: History
economy.ledger.about: What came in and went out.
economy.send.title: Send
economy.send.about: Give some of yours to another member.
economy.send.none: None of this server's currencies can be sent.
